name: AI Context x MCPconference Paris 2026
description: One-day technical conference on production AI agents and MCP
note: on-site, English (not stated); Luma ticket 99 EUR, series site shows 149 EUR
details:
Paris edition of the MCPconference / AI Context series by Dockland Media Group: a day of technical sessions, deployment case studies and panels for engineers and product leaders building AI infrastructure. Themes: production-grade agentic applications, AI tool connectivity protocols (Model Context Protocol), security and governance for enterprise deployments, and architectures from teams running agents in production.

The Luma page lists a 99 EUR ticket; the series site shows 149 EUR. The speaker list for Paris is not published yet. Venue: Campus Cyber in La Défense (Puteaux).
